# Coming in Phase 3

This hero doc is a **placeholder**. It will be authored in Phase 3 (roadmap task
3.1 — *agent showcase*) once the MCP server and the live demo's auto-API are
wired into an end-to-end agent narrative.

## What it will cover

- An LLM agent drives `iter8ml` through the **MCP server** (`iter8 mcp`), calling
  the same primitives a human CLI user does.
- The agent reuses the **Gradio demo's auto-exposed API** as an evaluation
  surface — the seam is `demo/app.py`'s `run_analysis()`, kept callable rather
  than buried in a Gradio callback.
- The same before/after framing as the
  [German Credit case study](case_study_german_credit.qmd), but with the agent
  choosing the path.

## Where to look now

- **MCP server setup:** see the `## MCP Server (Agentic ML)` section of the
  project `README.md`.
- **German Credit case study:** the reference loop this narrative will extend.
